captions.gbp:
A brain MRI that also measures. Advanced Medical Imaging offers NeuroQuant, FDA-cleared AI software that measures the volume of key brain structures, like the hippocampus, on a standard brain MRI and compares each value with people of the same age and sex. The MRI takes 30 to 45 minutes, with no contrast and no radiation, and the analysis adds no scan time. A board-certified radiologist combines the NeuroQuant report with the MRI read for your doctor. NeuroQuant does not diagnose Alzheimer's on its own: your doctor puts it together with memory tests and an exam, and memory changes have many causes, some of them treatable. Before your scan, eat and take your medicines as usual, leave jewelry at home, tell us about any implants or metal, and bring prior brain MRIs to compare. Self-pay NeuroQuant brain MRI is $999 with the radiologist reading included, and no referral is needed for self-pay. Insurance is accepted, with a doctor's order.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.

What it can and can't do: adds objective numbers to the MRI report; gives a baseline to compare with future scans; it doesn't diagnose Alzheimer's on its own, your doctor adds memory tests and an exam; memory changes have many causes and some are treatable.

Before your brain MRI: no fasting, eat and take your medicines as usual; leave jewelry, hair clips and piercings at home; tell us about implants, a pacemaker or any metal; bring prior brain MRIs on CD or USB to compare. Plan for about an hour.
Simple to book: $999 self-pay NeuroQuant brain MRI; no referral needed for self-pay; insurance accepted and benefits verified first; two centers, Seminole and St. Pete.
